title: Feedback on my pairs trading tool
author: Prestigious_Rich_123
selftext:
I’m doing pairs trading and **I'm looking for feedback** : I’ve been building a tool that scans thousands of stock and ETF pairs every day for cointegration. It lets you track the pairs you’re interested in and sends you alerts when the spread crosses your chosen threshold.

Its not an ad im really looking for feedback so if you are interested the name is pairscanner (.com)

Thanks to everyone who takes the time to check it out 🙏
